name: Chat Widget for FlowFunnel
author: flowfunnel

sections.description:
Chat Widget for FlowFunnel makes it easy to add a professional WhatsApp chat widget to your WordPress website. Connect with your visitors instantly and improve customer support with this lightweight, customizable solution.

Key Features

  • Floating Chat Button – Add a sticky WhatsApp button that stays visible as users scroll
  • Multiple Icon Styles – Choose from classic, circle, or modern button designs
  • Customizable Position – Place the button on bottom-right or bottom-left of your site
  • Inquiry Options – Create pre-defined message options for different types of inquiries
  • International Support – Support for 40+ country codes and phone number formats
  • Click Analytics – Track how many times your chat options are clicked
  • Mobile Responsive – Optimized display for all screen sizes
  • Easy Setup – Simple configuration through WordPress admin panel
  • Lightweight – Minimal impact on site performance
  • Accessibility Ready – Screen reader friendly with proper ARIA labels

Perfect For

  • E-commerce stores needing customer support
  • Service businesses wanting direct contact
  • Restaurants taking orders via WhatsApp
  • Real estate agents connecting with clients
  • Any website wanting to improve visitor engagement

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Settings > Chat Widget for flowfunnel.io
  3. Enter your WhatsApp number with country code
  4. Customize the button style and position
  5. Add inquiry options (optional)
  6. Save settings and the widget appears on your site

When visitors click the chat button, they can either start a direct chat or choose from your pre-defined inquiry options. All interactions open WhatsApp with your number and optional pre-filled message.

Inquiry Options Examples

  • “I need product support”
  • “I want to place an order”
  • “I have a question about pricing”
  • “I need technical assistance”
  • “General inquiry”

Privacy & GDPR Compliant

The plugin only collects click analytics if enabled, and stores minimal data locally. No personal information is transmitted to external services except for the standard WhatsApp interaction.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit our support page or contact us through the WordPress.org support forum.

Credits

  • Developed by FlowFunnel
  • Icons by Font Awesome
  • UI styling with Tailwind CSS
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Login to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Chat Widget for FlowFunnel”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Login to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Go to Settings > Chat Widget for flowfunnel.io
  2. Enter your WhatsApp number (including country code)
  3. Choose your preferred button style and position
  4. Add inquiry options if desired
  5. Save your settings
sections.faq:
Do I need a WhatsApp Business account?

No, the plugin works with both regular WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business accounts. However, WhatsApp Business is recommended for professional use.

Can I customize the button colors?

The plugin comes with three pre-designed styles optimized for WhatsApp branding. Custom CSS can be added for further customization.

Will this slow down my website?

No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance. It loads minimal CSS and JavaScript only when needed.

Can I track analytics?

Yes, the plugin includes basic click tracking to see how many times each inquiry option is clicked. This data is stored locally in your WordPress database.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! The chat widget is fully responsive and provides an excellent experience on all devices.

Can I use this plugin on multiple sites?

Yes, you can use this plugin on multiple WordPress sites. Each site will need its own configuration.

What countries are supported?

The plugin supports 40+ country codes including USA, UK, India, Germany, France, Canada, Australia, and many more.

Can I hide the attribution link?

Yes, the attribution link is disabled by default. You can optionally enable it in the plugin settings to support the developers.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with popular caching plugins like WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, and WP Super Cache.

Can I customize the inquiry messages?

Yes, you can add, edit, or remove inquiry options from the admin panel. Each option creates a pre-filled WhatsApp message.
